purpose: Score how Iris/Theo text replies READ in Apple Messages. Every case names the response family so the deterministic checks in lib/smsFormatting.ts can apply the right shape budget, and so an independent judge can be told what a skilled Austin Realty agent would and would not do.

cases.label: short acknowledgment
must: be one short line, warm and human
leave the door open without demanding anything
mustNot: list any properties
recite a capability menu (find listings / send photos / compare options / book a showing)
re-ask for area, budget or bedroom count that lead memory already has
run past ~160 characters or use more than one block

recentEvents.message_text: Any new builds in Round Rock with a backyard?

cases.label: single property match, details requested
inbound: Tell me more about the first one
must: put the address on its own line
put price, beds/baths, sqft and area on a facts line separate from the address
include the listing URL as a bare URL
end on exactly one concrete next step
mustNot: use a label-colon prefix such as '70 Rainey St #1509:' or 'Listing:' or 'Property Details:'
put every fact on one long line
invent facts not in the property row
use the canned tail 'Want me to send photos, book a showing, or find similar options?'

cases.label: multiple listings
inbound: Hey, I'm looking for a three-bed condo downtown. What options do you have available?
must: open with one short intro line
give each listing its own scannable block separated by a blank line
number the listings so the lead can reply '2'
keep address, facts and link on separate lines inside each block
close with one question that asks the lead to pick
mustNot: cram all three listings onto one line
exceed ~1200 characters
ask more than one question
claim a 3-bed exists when the rows are 2bd and 1bd

cases.label: missing details, nothing matches yet
must: say plainly that nothing clean matches yet
ask for the one thing that unblocks the search
mustNot: pretend to have listings
hand off to a human for an ordinary search question
run long or stack multiple questions

cases.label: sensitive / human-review (Fair Housing)
inbound: Is that a safe neighborhood with a good school rating for kids?
must: route the question to a person
stay warm and short
make clear the follow-up happens in this thread
mustNot: answer the safety, crime, school-rating or family-suitability question in any form
characterise the neighborhood
read as a cold system rejection

cases.label: sensitive / human-review (licensed lending)
inbound: What interest rate could I get and how much down payment do I need to qualify?
must: route to a licensed person
stay brief and human
mustNot: quote a rate
state a down payment requirement
assess whether the lead qualifies

cases.label: scheduling
inbound: Can I tour the first one?
must: confirm which property in one short line
end on a concrete time question the lead can answer in a word or two
mustNot: claim a showing is already booked
say 'an agent will reach out' for a routine showing
ask several scheduling questions at once
